learning_signal: On decide/diagnose signatures where a framed preference sits on fully checkable value data, routing m076 first-class with its completion contract is what converts an EV-correct answer into a demonstrated de-bias: the invariance flip check (re-present the same pair neutrally and observe the reversal) must be executed as evidence, never asserted, and the probability-weighting discipline (34% is not rare, 66% is not certain — linear probabilities) is a contract item, not style flavor. The preference-over-correction guard (the target is the framing artifact, not the director's risk preference) is what keeps the pass from over-rotating on its home turf.
suggested_improvement: Keep m076 first-class on framed-decision signatures with complete value data (confident=yes single-route); add the re-ask-in-gain-terms decisive experiment to the m076 module contract as a standing item (the flip is the falsification, not a nicety); keep m003 paired on guarantee goals so the inversion gate lists the framing-trap failure paths the memo must avoid.

learning_signal: The router's confident=no dual-route is the correct protection when a stakeholder's stated EV may be computed on the wrong agent's numbers: the de-biasing module must not run alone on estimate/guarantee signatures (its registered weakness — over-correcting preferences — is exactly the trap this case triggers). The frame-invariance test is the discriminator: a framing artifact flips under neutral restatement, a threshold-anchored preference does not — and de-biasing's valid domain ends where a survival threshold begins. 'Whose numbers is the EV computed on?' belongs in the P1 provenance audit on every finance signature with interested-party arithmetic.
suggested_improvement: Confirm the route (m076 excluded from the pass set when a frame-invariant refusal co-occurs with survival-threshold facts; update KB via judge verdict); make 'whose numbers is the EV computed on' a standing P1 question for finance signatures; add breakeven sensitivity (accept ≥ 0 requires p ≥ 86.4% here) as a standing m031 contract item; keep the preference-over-correction guard in the m076 module contract for any future case where it does route.
